title: selaginella arenicola var. acanthonota
intro: Selaginella arenicola var. acanthonota, commonly known as a type of spikemoss, is a species of plant in the genus Selaginella. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella arenicola var. acanthonota are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds. However, due to limited research, more studies are needed to confirm the exact health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
